dims.why: CLAUDE.md, twelve times bitten: read the count off the run. A figure typed into a page is the defect this repository keeps paying for.
dims.how: Two for a measurement file in the family, Two for the page carrying a stamp: a commit, an md5 or a timestamp.

dims.nm: Refuses to build without its data
dims.why: The gates: a build that proceeds with its data missing prints a page of nothing and calls it a result.
dims.how: A builder or probe script in the family that exits non zero on a missing input. Four with the guard, two for a script with none, nothing with no script.

dims.why: A figure nobody can regenerate is a claim. The two simulation pages print their own chain.
dims.how: The deliverable page naming the command that rebuilds it.

dims.why: The house voice is a ruling, not a preference, and it has a runnable gate.
dims.how: The repository voice gate run against the deliverable pages. Four minus one for each hard failure.

dims.why: A point is only earned by a change that would move the product, named with the file it lands in. That rule was written for the simulation and it is the same rule here.
dims.how: Distinct paths under atuned_src named in the deliverable pages. Two for one, four for two or more.

dims.why: DECISIONS.md and the queue: an artefact that names nothing open has either decided something it does not own or hidden the question.
dims.how: Counts the page saying what it is not doing, what needs a ruling, and whose call it is. This is the weakest of the eight and it is a word search.
